methods.name: Attention multiscale U-Net
methods.summary: A U-Net based semantic segmentation architecture that integrates attention gates to suppress irrelevant features and highlight important ones, trained using transfer learning from the HR-GLDD dataset and fine-tuned on temporal difference imagery.
methods.source: Abhilash Sreekumar, Hemalatha Thirugnanam, Sansar Raj Meena, Maneesha Vinodini Ramesh
methods.verbatim: Code for the implementation performed in this paper is available at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10Af7fvUl2lnD-7imm04WAlZhtNtXvHI1?usp=sharing.
